whenToUse: Display advertising on a news, magazine or blog page, with the space reserved before the ad loads.
House ads or sponsor slots that need the same labelled box (consent={false} when nothing tracks).
avoidWhen: Promoting your own product inside an app — use announcement-bar or a card.
Pages without a consent banner for ad cookies — add consent-banner first.
a11y: An aside landmark named by its visible label ("Advertisement").
The box keeps its ratio before loading, so nothing jumps under the reader (no layout shift).
